recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-shot portrait of a man with shaggy hair sitting on a stone structure in a sun-drenched park, framed by weeping willow trees and featuring heavy, interlocking bubble-style typography in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a lush, textured green background
Typography overlapping the foliage but avoiding the subject's face
Warm, slightly yellowed color cast suggesting aged paper and film
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows in the clothing folds
coreInvariants: Heavy grain and surface wear (scuffs, ring wear)
Interlocking lowercase-style letterforms with thick outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-full shot, occupying the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, stylized text block in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold text in the upper left, down to the subject's face, following the line of the arms to the base of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense foliage on the left balanced by an open grassy field on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted moss greens and olive tones in the background foliage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues in the subject's trousers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm ochre and yellow outlines on the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, desaturated yellow tint across the entire image; high value contrast in the subject's shirt.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy greens, browns, and warm neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, rounded sans-serif with liquid-like connections.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders shortened to maintain a block-like footprint
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face; no secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s style analog photograph of a man with shaggy hair and a green button-down shirt sitting on a stone in a park with weeping willow trees. Apply heavy film grain, a warm yellow tint, and circular scuff marks to simulate an old vinyl record cover.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom interlocking bubble lettering in the top left corner. Use a thick yellow outline and a muted green fill. Ensure the letters touch and create a solid block shape.

verificationChecks: Does the text interlock without gaps?
Is the color palette restricted to 70s earth tones?
Is there visible analog-style grain and wear?
Is the lighting warm and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Density of the willow tree background
Intensity of the yellow color cast
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography has a double-stroke outline
Verify the subject's hair style matches the 70s era
Confirm the background foliage feels dense and organic
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a central outdoor portrait + apply 70s warm film filter + add interlocking bubble display type in the upper quadrant + finish with analog print textures.
